provider_policy.exact_provider_requirement: provider name must be logged in retained run artifacts without secrets
provider_policy.base_url_policy: exact base_url or endpoint family must be logged in retained run artifacts without secrets
provider_policy.exception_rule: any provider/model/base_url deviation requires a documented benchmark-side exception before the run

model_config.seed_policy: record if available; otherwise leave explicit null

forbidden: manual prompt rewriting after row inspection

demo_constraints: no ad hoc corpus change after target inspection
no manual override of retrieved examples after inspection
no reuse of benchmark-produced generated SQL as retrieval demos

retrieval_parameters.selection_rule: actual run must log retrieval mode, top_k, threshold if any, reranking if any, selected rules, and retrieval trace

rule_vector_alignment_policy.freeze_rule: embedding dimension, rule-vector dimension, and retrieval index dimension must match under a deterministic documented policy
rule_vector_alignment_policy.forbidden: no exploratory patching in a benchmark-facing run
rule_vector_alignment_policy.failure_rule: dimension mismatch blocks the row; it must not be silently patched during benchmark evidence generation

blocked_items_before_current_evidence: exact retrieval top_k must be frozen
exact retrieval threshold/reranking contract must be frozen
rule-vector alignment must become deterministic rather than exploratory patch behavior
contamination guard must be attested in run artifacts
artifact contract must be satisfied on a formal denominator-aware run
